remarks: Step into a world of elegance and history at Orchard Ridge, an extraordinary estate with an illustrious past. This magnificent property has been home to notable figures such as Faith Hill & Tim McGraw during the filming of Stepford Wives, GE CEO, Jack Welch, and the philanthropic Dunning family, known for their contributions to NC's Dunning Field/Stadium. Property Highlights: 6.6 acres of spectacular private property with sweeping lawns, rows of varietal apple trees and perennial gardens with beautiful rolling landscapes. Main House: 7 Fireplaces, 6 Bedrooms, 7 Bathrooms Chef's-Grade Country Kitchen: Perfect for culinary enthusiasts. Entertaining Spaces: Large rooms designed for hosting gatherings. Family Gathering Rooms: Cozy & inviting light-filled spaces. Elegant Living Room: Featuring walls of windows & 9+ ft ceilings. Primary Suite: Sitting room, spacious dressing areas, and a professional-level gym. Bedrooms: 6 bedrooms in the main house, offering ample space for everyone. Guest Cottage: A separate cottage with an additional bedroom, kitchenette, full bath and laundry. Amenities: Tennis Court, Swimming Pool, Pool House with full kitchen for poolside entertaining and cabana with bathroom & shower. Orchard Ridge is more than just a home; it's a sophisticated retreat that offers the best of New Canaan living.
